'''Meeva''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] child who was born on and lived her early years on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the years of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Abducted from her parents at a very early age, she was taken by [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] who intended to train her as a dancer and then sell her for a hefty profit. While in the slavers' custody Meeva met another young Twi'lek, a male named [[Tror]], who had been sold to the slavers by his parents. A few months after Tror arrived, a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] named [[Vhiin Thorla]] located the slavers' camp and rescued both Meeva and Tror from slavery. Taking both of the young Twi'leks back to [[The Enclave]], a refuge built for former slaves, Master Thorla introduced them to other Twi'leks who had been liberated from a life of slavery. Not long after their arrival, Master Thorla brought another child Twi'lek to the Enclave, a rescued slave named [[Dath]]. The three children became quick friends and were rarely seen without the others' company.
